load_policy.normal_run: Refresh seven completed UTC days plus a two-day creation buffer.
load_policy.initial_run: Backfill 30 completed UTC days once; larger manual backfills remain available up to 90 days.
notes: The page size is intentionally small because larger nested-payment queries timed out during development.
Every HTTP attempt, including a retry, counts against the hard request budget.
HTTP 401, 403, 407, and 429 responses stop the run without retrying.
A failed or budget-exhausted run records diagnostics but does not replace daily observations.
